title: 第19章 师姐暗留心第20章 姜瑶开公司
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
慕云汐讲法被打断，她那双如秋水般的眸子微微一凝。
灵识如丝线般扫过全场，很快锁定了施法者——
一个看起来平平无奇的外门弟子，修为不过炼气一层。
但就是这样一个炼气一层的小修士，刚才瞬发出的火球术，威力竟然堪比炼气三层！
更让她震惊的是，凝聚这个火球所消耗的灵力波动，微弱得几乎可以忽略。
按照常理，如此威力的火球术，至少需要消耗三到五缕灵力，可刚才那个弟子，最多只用了一缕！
这根本不合常理，甚至违反了术法最基本的能量守恒法则。
有趣……慕云汐心中涌起久违的好奇。
作为极品天灵根，她见过太多天才，但能让她感到意外的人，屈指可数。
林渊背上冷汗直冒，豆大的汗珠顺着额角滑落。
他心头咯噔一下，暗道一声“坏了”，脑子飞速转动着应对之策。
法诀一收，胸前那枚灼热的火球凭空消散，整个过程干脆利落，没有一丝能量外泄，仿佛刚才那恐怖的火球只是幻觉。
他立刻垂下头，恨不得找个地缝钻进去，心中暗骂自己太冲动了。
这份收放自如的精妙控制力，让慕云汐眼中的惊讶又深了一分。
她那如秋水般的眸子深处，多了探究和……几乎察觉不到的赞赏。
不仅威力惊人，控制力也如此精妙……这个弟子，绝不简单。
死寂只持续了极短的一瞬，人群中随即爆发出压抑不住的低语，像一锅烧沸的开水。
“疯了吧？”
“一个炼气一层的小喽啰，也敢在慕师姐讲法时捣乱？”
“不就是想引起仙子注意吗？”

有人低声说，语气里满是鄙夷和嫉妒。
“呵，癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉，也不去看看自己什么德行！”
“真是不知死活！”
另一人附和，声音带刺。
“笑死人了，以为凭着一个古怪火球就能博得美人一笑？”
“慕师姐是何等人物，岂会看上他这种哗众取宠的货色？”
一个高个弟子不屑地嗤笑，眼中满是讥讽。
“我看他那火球也未必是真本事，八成是偷偷藏了什么一次性法器，就为了在这关键时刻出风头。”
“真是卑鄙！”
旁边有人猜测，语气酸涩无比。
“真是蠢货，仗着一点小伎俩，就想攀高枝？”
“简直是修行界的败类，把仙子讲法的神圣地方当成什么了？”
“让人恶心！”
有人语气加重，明显是慕云汐的狂热崇拜者。
“等着看吧，看他以后怎么在宗门混，这下丢人丢到姥姥家了，怕不是要被赶出青阳宗！”
“活该！”
更多的弟子开始指指点点，窃窃私语，各种恶毒的猜测和诅咒不绝于耳。
听到这些议论，林渊紧绷的神经反倒松了下来。
呼……幸好他们都以为我是为了博慕仙子一笑。
他心里暗自庆幸。

这样也好，至少不会有人真的深究我炼气一层怎么能发出那种威力的火球。
这些鄙夷的目光和恶毒的猜测，反而成了最好的掩护。
他正暗自庆幸，心头却猛地一跳。
高台上，慕云汐已经讲道完毕。
她转身准备离去，但那双清冷的眸子却有意无意地扫过林渊所在的方向。
content_en:
Mu Yunxi's lecture was interrupted, and her autumn-like eyes narrowed slightly.
Spiritual consciousness swept across the entire scene like a thread and quickly locked onto the caster——
An ordinary-looking outer sect disciple whose cultivation level is only at the first level of Qi refining.
But for such a young monk who was on the first level of Qi Refining, the fireball technique he just fired instantly was as powerful as that on the third level of Qi Refining!
What shocked her even more was that the fluctuation of spiritual power consumed to condense this fireball was so weak that it could almost be ignored.
According to common sense, such a powerful fireball technique requires at least three to five rays of spiritual power, but the disciple just now only used one ray at most!
This is completely unreasonable and even violates the most basic law of energy conservation.
Interesting... Mu Yunxi felt a long-lost curiosity in her heart.
As the best Tianlinggen, she has seen too many geniuses, but there are only a handful of people who can surprise her.
Cold sweat broke out on Lin Yuan's back, and big beads of sweat slid down his forehead.
His heart skipped a beat, and he secretly thought, "It's broken." His mind was racing with countermeasures.
As soon as the magic technique was withdrawn, the scorching fireball in his chest dissipated out of thin air. The whole process was neat and tidy, without any energy leaking out, as if the terrifying fireball just now was just an illusion.
He immediately lowered his head, wishing to find a crack in the ground to crawl in, cursing himself for being too impulsive.
This exquisite control ability made the surprise in Mu Yunxi's eyes even deeper.
In the depths of her autumn-like eyes, there was more inquiry and... an almost imperceptible admiration.
Not only is the power astonishing, but the control is also so exquisite... This disciple is anything but simple.
The dead silence only lasted for a brief moment, and then the crowd erupted into uncontrollable whispers, like a pot of boiling water.
"Are you crazy?"
"A little guy who is at the first level of Qi Refining dares to cause trouble when Senior Sister Mu is teaching the Fa?"
"Aren't you just trying to attract the fairy's attention?"
Someone whispered, with a tone full of contempt and jealousy.
"Oh, the toad wants to eat the swan's meat, but he doesn't even bother to check his own virtue!"
"It's so reckless!"
Another echoed, his voice stinging.
"You're so ridiculous. Do you think you can win a smile from a beautiful woman with a weird fireball?"
"What kind of person is Senior Sister Mu? How could she fall in love with a sensationalist like him?"
A tall disciple sneered disdainfully, his eyes full of sarcasm.
"I think his fireball may not be a real skill. It's probably a one-time weapon secretly hidden just to show off at this critical moment."
"How despicable!"
Someone next to me guessed, with a very sour tone.
"What a fool, trying to reach a higher level with just a few tricks?"
"You are simply a scum in the spiritual world. What do you think of the sacred place where fairies teach?"
"Disgusting!"
Someone's tone increased, and he was obviously a fanatical admirer of Mu Yunxi.
"Let's wait and see how he hangs out in the sect in the future. Now that he has been humiliated at his grandma's house, I'm afraid he will be kicked out of the Qingyang Sect!"
"Deserve it!"
More disciples began to point, whisper, and hear all kinds of vicious speculations and curses.
Hearing these discussions, Lin Yuan's tense nerves relaxed.
Phew...fortunately they all thought I was smiling just to impress the fairy.
He was secretly glad.
This is good, at least no one will really dig into how I can emit such powerful fireballs at the first level of Qi Refining.
These contemptuous glances and vicious speculations have become the best cover.
He was secretly rejoicing when his heart skipped a beat.
On the high platform, Mu Yunxi had finished her sermon.
She turned around to leave, but those cold eyes glanced in Lin Yuan's direction intentionally or unintentionally.
